basic_info.description: Dont miss this rare opportunity to own a charming Victorian building in San Franciscos highly sought-after Mission District. Listed as a duplex but consisting of three legal units (with city approval provided in the disclosure packet), the property includes one three-bedroom unit and two one-bedroom units. Ideally located near BART and Muni with a Walk Score of 99, this is an excellent income-producing asset in a vibrant, walkable neighborhood full of shops, restaurants, and amenities. The top-floor and center units are currently vacant, offering strong value-add potential. The center unit features sliding glass doors that lead to a private deck and backyardperfect for outdoor living. Whether youre an investor or looking to occupy and generate income, this property offers location, flexibility, and upside in one of San Franciscos most in-demand areas.
